Studio.intro: Choose what you want to work on. Studio data is saved to your permanent characters and worlds, without session-only mechanics.
Studio.characterDescription: Create and maintain characters before joining a game.
Studio.worldDescription: Build scenes, NPCs, assets, notes, and world settings.
Studio.chooseExisting: Choose an existing {entity} to edit or create a new one.
Studio.createFirst: Create your first {entity} to start building.
Studio.deleteDescription: This action permanently removes the {entity} and its related files.
Studio.leaveHelp: You can save your changes, keep editing, or leave without saving.
Studio.nameDescriptionRequired: Add a character name and description to enable saving.
Studio.worldNameRequired: Add a world name to enable saving.
